articles.title: 2 people accused of defrauding Ajax FC Soccer Club of over $650K: police
articles.summary: Two people who were employed at the Ajax FC Soccer Club have been charged after allegedly defrauding more than $650,000 of league funds, Durham police have found.

articles.title: Passengers stranded for hours on stalled GO Train near Union Station
articles.summary: They were so close, yet so far. Several passengers on a Lakeshore West GO train say they were stranded for up to two hours after the train stalled not far from its destination at Union Station. articles.title: New bus-only roadway on former Scarborough RT route will shorten commute times: TTC
articles.summary: Some Scarborough commuters will have their travel time shortened, the TTC says, thanks to the opening of the new Scarborough Busway on Wednesday.

articles.title: Motorcyclist dead in Oakville after crash with car: Halton police
articles.summary: A person has died after a crash in Oakville on Tuesday night, said Halton police.

articles.title: Police release images and description of pickup truck involved in fatal Mississauga hit and run
articles.summary: Police have released a description of a pickup truck that they believe fatally struck a man in his 60s in a hit and run in Mississauga on Tuesday.

articles.title: Ontario health-care coalition denounces province's plan to remove bike lanes across Toronto
articles.summary: A coalition of Ontario health-care workers gathered in downtown Toronto on Tuesday to denounce the provincial government’s plan to remove bike lanes on three major roadways across the city.
